situation.line: Activity ran at about the same level in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept, seven logged incidents against seven in the window before. The weight was spread across five fronts — Western Taiz and Al-Wazi'iyah; Bab al-Mandab and the south-west coast; Marib among them — comprising three ground engagements and four reported strikes.

fronts.name: Bab al-Mandab and the south-west coast
fronts.line: The strait and the high ground above it carry the shipping lane between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept the desk logged one ground engagement. Activity here is up on the previous window.

fronts.name: Red Sea coast
fronts.line: The Red Sea coast controls access to Hodeidah, the main import route for the north. Nothing was reported from this front in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept.

fronts.name: Western Taiz and Al-Wazi'iyah
fronts.line: Western Taiz is the hinge between the coast and the highlands, and the approach to Taiz city. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept the desk logged two ground engagements. Activity here is down on the previous window.

fronts.name: Marib
fronts.line: Marib holds Yemen's main oil and gas infrastructure and the government's northern stronghold. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept the desk logged one ground engagement.

fronts.name: Al-Dhale and Lahj
fronts.line: Al-Dhale and Lahj sit astride the roads north from Aden. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept the desk logged one ground engagement.

fronts.name: Al-Jawf
fronts.line: Al-Jawf is the northern desert flank, linking Marib to the Saudi border. In the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept the desk logged one reported strike.

fronts.name: The Saudi home front
fronts.line: The Saudi home front is where long-range fire and air defence alerts register inside the kingdom. Nothing was reported from this front in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept.

fronts.name: Energy and shipping
fronts.line: Energy and shipping is where the fighting reaches oil exports and the Red Sea corridor. Nothing was reported from this front in the 12 hours to 12:00 on 21 Sept. It has been quiet across recent windows.
